verdict.rationale: Smooth's session workflow lets a developer send step-level natural-language actions (`run_task`, `goto`, `extract`, `evaluate_js`) to a persistent browser. It handles forms, dropdowns and checkboxes, and its extraction needs no selectors, so it offers a coarse-grained, selector-free form of describing actions. However, it documents no granular act/click/type primitives on described elements, and nothing shows behavior that survives selector or layout changes. Missing for 10: dedicated act/click/type primitives targeting described elements, documented robustness to selector/layout changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
